evals.notes: US T1 inventory with fill >90% and avg_cpm far below bid peak midpoint ($1.00). Should trigger RAISE rule. recommended_floor must exceed the low bound of the bid density peak ($0.80). Revenue impact must be positive given floor is being raised toward actual market clearing price.

IN T3 inventory with fill <30% and avg_cpm ($2.00) massively above T3-adjusted bid peak midpoint (~$0.056). Should trigger LOWER rule. recommended_floor must be below current avg_cpm. analysis_summary must explicitly state the floor reduction directive.

UK T1 inventory with fill in equilibrium band (30–90%). Should trigger CALIBRATE rule at 90% of bid peak midpoint ($1.00 × 0.90 = $0.90). Validates that a recommendation is always produced and revenue impact is always populated.
